name: AutoTradeProject_DesignDocSet_Orchestrator_v0_1
display_name: Auto Trade Project Design Document Set Orchestrator v0.1
purpose: Coordinate creation and revision of multi-document formal HTML design sets within a phase while preserving traceability, common metadata, review history, Human Gates, and doc/index.html reachability.
trigger_examples: Phase 2の設計書セットを作成して
複数のHTML設計書を一括で整合させて
設計書作成が多いステップをDesignDocSet Orchestratorで進めて

runtime_dispatch_contract.root_dispatch: Use direct local execution by default. Select child components automatically only when the design-set task needs independent work; do not require or persist a root receipt.
runtime_dispatch_contract.coordinator_dispatch: When child work is needed, automatically select the smallest set of components by responsibility and input boundary. Do not require user-supplied names or persist child receipts.
runtime_dispatch_contract.fixed_model_policy: Prompt model labels are constraints: the runtime must resolve the exact Orchestrator and Agent JSON and reject silent model substitution.
runtime_dispatch_contract.fallback_policy: If child dispatch is unnecessary or unavailable, continue with direct execution. Never claim independent execution that did not occur. Do not create fallback packets for ordinary design work.

workflow_policy: Validate only the relevant components and requested Phase Runbook fields; do not require user-supplied component names.
Load only the target document inputs needed for the requested formal design-set output.
Automatically select source extraction, domain, writer, and review components when their responsibility materially improves the requested design quality.
Use A81 and A80 only when a formal HTML design set or its user-facing documentation is requested; update doc/index.html only when reachability changes.
Use A90 for findings-first review when the requested design scope or safety risk warrants it.
Use A95 only for a direct management-hash reintroduction concern. A95 must not calculate hashes, write manifests, or create hash receipts.
Stop for external I/O, Secret, destructive data, unresolved safety findings, or explicit Human Gates; do not create a Gate packet for ordinary design work.
stop_conditions: No suitable component exists for a responsibility that is directly required by the requested design output.
The requested document set scope cannot be inferred from inputs.
A requested formal HTML artifact would be left unreachable from doc/index.html after the requested document change.
An Unknown would need to be treated as Pass.
A review finding affecting safety, Secret handling, or fail-closed behavior would be removed without adoption reasoning.
Changing default_orchestrator would be required without explicit approval.
